result.reason: The redline reaches the 90-day fallback period for Deliverables and retains repair, replacement, re-performance, and refund remedies, but it does not expressly provide a 30-day Services warranty and contains no operative compliance-with-laws or no-malicious-code warranties. Section 19.3 cannot be credited because its text was not supplied. In addition, stating that the period does not limit “any other remedy” unnecessarily broadens the original remedy structure, which otherwise made remedies nonexclusive only for specified claims.
